summary: Russian forces struck the Kiev Innovation Terminal 'Nova Poshta' and a plant producing Flamingo missile control systems and drone components in Kiev. Multiple ballistic missiles and Shahed-type drones targeted Kiev, Chernihiv, Zaporizhzhia, Mykolaiv and Odesa regions. Ukrainian drones attacked the KTK marine terminal and oil depots in Stavropol and Moscow regions.
key_points: Russian forces struck the Kiev Innovation Terminal 'Nova Poshta' used for dual-use storage and an OOO Oakline plant making Dip Strike drone parts in Kiev (Source: @tass_agency/385925).
Russian MoD reported strikes on a Kiev enterprise producing control systems for FP-5 Flamingo missiles (Source: @tass_agency/385923).
Four ballistic missiles were reported heading to Kiev alongside two and four additional ballistic launches in separate alerts (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69211).
Reactive Shahed drones approached Kiev from the north and a ballistic missile passed Chernihiv toward Kiev (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69237).
Ukrainian drones attacked the KTK marine terminal; two tankers with international crews were hit and oil loading stopped (Source: @tass_agency/385932).
Russian Geran-4 siker drones struck a railway locomotive transporting Ukrainian equipment in Zaporozhye region (Source: @tass_agency/385920).
Ukrainian drone attacks hit an oil depot in Mikhailovsk, Stavropol Krai, third time in two weeks (Source: @eRadarrua/101653).
Russia warns of elevated Kh-22/32 missile threat from Tu-22M3 bombers within 48h for Odesa, Chornomorsk, Pivdenne, Chornomorske (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69246).

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces struck the Kiev Innovation Terminal 'Nova Poshta' and a plant producing Flamingo missile control systems and drone components in Kiev. Multiple ballistic missiles and reactive drones targeted Kiev, Chernihiv, Zaporizhzhia, Mykolaiv and Odesa regions over the period. Ukrainian drones attacked the KTK marine terminal and oil depots in Stavropol and Moscow regions.

points: Russian forces struck the Kiev Innovation Terminal 'Nova Poshta' which conducts delivery and storage of dual-use products, and OOO Oakline producing Dip Strike drone components, per MoD (Source: @tass_agency/385925).
Russian strikes in Kiev hit an enterprise manufacturing control systems for FP-5 Flamingo missiles, according to the Russian Ministry of Defense (Source: @tass_agency/385923).
Four ballistic missiles were reported inbound to Kiev, with separate alerts of two and four more ballistic missiles and reactive Shaheds from the north (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69211).
A courtyard on Lukyanivka was destroyed in Kiev and air raid alerts were declared with all-clear at 03:14 and 10:16 on 19.07.2026 (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69227).
Russian forces destroyed two dry cargo ships with military cargo at Odesa port and hit a ship with Ukrainian Armed Forces cargo at Yuzhny port (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31734).
Armed Forces of Russia struck Sumy with seven KABs; three injured hospitalized and one possibly under rubble per OVA head Hryhorov (Source: @UkraineNow/82763).
Ukrainian drones attacked the KTK marine terminal; two sea tankers with international crews were attacked by UAVs and oil loading halted (Source: @tass_agency/385932).
A Ukrainian drone attack was repelled near Stavropol; a fire occurred in the industrial zone of Shpakovsky district per governor (Source: @tass_agency/385936).
Ukrainian drone strikes hit an oil depot in Mikhailovsk, Stavropol Krai, third time in two weeks per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101653).
Ukrainian forces struck an oil depot in Moscow region, tankers and guard ship Svetlyak in Kerch, and a railway bridge over Belaya river in Luhansk region (Source: @UkraineNow/82745).
Ukrainian drone attack footage shows fire after strike on oil base in Stavropol Krai per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101695).
Two Majors summary states Russian strikes on enemy rear escalated, targeting maritime infrastructure, Odessa region, vessels, and Kiev with missiles (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31741).
Russian Geran-4 siker drones struck a railway locomotive used to transport Ukrainian equipment in Zaporozhye region per MoD (Source: @tass_agency/385920).
Russian KABs were dropped on southern Dnipropetrovsk region from Donetsk region per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/69167).
Russian forces struck Sumy with seven KABs; three injured and one possibly under rubble, rescue ongoing (Source: @UkraineNow/82763).
A passenger train in Zaporizhzhia region was attacked by drones; one conductor lightly wounded, evacuation ordered in time (Source: @UkraineNow/82763).
Reactive drones passed Zaporizhzhia airport toward Dnipropetrovsk and one strike drone toward Komyshuvakha per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101701).
Reactive drones were reported toward Zaporizhzhia from the south per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/69175).
Reactive Shahed drones approached Kiev from the north and a ballistic missile passed Chernihiv toward Kiev per mon1tor_ua (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69237).
Reactive drones headed toward Nizhyn in Chernihiv region from northeast and toward Olyshivka from east per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/69125).
Reactive drone in Nizhyn district Chernihiv region on southwest course and toward Novgorod-Seversky from southeast per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/69135).
Chernihiv: reactive drone past Korop; Sumy: reactive drone along border near Rylsk per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101655).
Poltava: two drones near Hadyach; Chernihiv: reactive toward Nizhyn and Ponornytsia, reconnaissance near Novgorod-Seversky per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101664).
Kharkiv: drone toward Kharkiv from northwest and toward Chuhuiv from northeast per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/69182).
Three guided drones headed to Mykolaiv region, Ochakiv, from the spit per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101699).
Mykolaiv: drone east of Ochakiv on northeast course and toward Berezanka from southeast per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/69183).
Drone toward Odesa/Black Sea from Black Sea waters per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/69133).
Guided reactive drone from sea toward Odesa Bay per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101670).
Elevated Kh-22/32 threat from Tu-22M3 bombers within 48h for Odesa, Chornomorsk, Pivdenne, Chornomorske per mon1tor_ua (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69246).
Russian forces destroyed two dry cargo ships with military cargo at Odesa and hit ship at Yuzhny per ukr_leaks_eng (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31734).
Russian MoD reported Geran-4 siker strikes on railway locomotive in Zaporozhye transporting Ukrainian equipment (Source: @tass_agency/385920).
Ballistic threat declared then stood down; four ballistic missiles and two ballistic missiles reported inbound to Kiev (Source: @kpszsu/69173).
Reactive drones and ballistic missiles targeted Kiev, Chernihiv, Zaporizhzhia, Mykolaiv, Odesa per multiple kpszsu and mon1tor_ua posts.
Russian Geran drones increasingly use single manual control attacks per ex-MoD adviser Beskrestnov (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31733).
Elevated Kh-22/32 missile threat from Tu-22M3 within 48h for Odesa area per mon1tor_ua (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69246).
Air raid all-clears in Kiev at 03:14 and 10:16 on 19.07.2026 per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101652).

sections.threat_assessment: Russian strikes on Kiev now target dual-use and missile production sites including Nova Poshta terminal and Flamingo control plants, indicating deep precision campaign. Elevated Kh-22/32 threat from Tu-22M3 within 48h endangers Odesa and Black Sea ports. Ukrainian drone retaliation against Russian oil and maritime assets is intensifying, hitting KTK terminal and Stavropol depots. Escalation in rear-area strikes by both sides raises risk to civilians and logistics.
sections.regional_response: Botswana ministry warned citizens are deceived into fighting for Russia against Ukraine, with cases rapidly growing (Source: @UkraineNow/82753). NATO's promised €140 billion to Ukraine over two years may be unfulfillable due to uneven burden share per NZZ (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31736). Germany and UK lead European military aid at ~€10bn in first four months of 2026; France, Italy, Spain lag. Occupied Crimea installs stationary emergency phones amid power limits (Source: @UkraineNow/82764).
sections.intelligence_notes: Two Majors summary states Russian rear strikes escalated to hit Odessa maritime infrastructure and Kiev missiles, likely politically authorized (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31741). Russian Geran drones shift to manual single attacks per Beskrestnov (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31733). Ukraine struck oil depot Moscow, Svetlyak Kerch, and Luhansk rail bridge (Source: @UkraineNow/82745). Botswana citizens coerced into Russian ranks shows recruitment fraud expanding (Source: @UkraineNow/82753).
